scripts.deploy:api: pnpm --filter pinthread build:setup && wrangler deploy --config packages/pinthread/server/hosted.jsonc
scripts.preview:site: pnpm build && wrangler versions upload --config packages/pinthread-site/wrangler.jsonc --preview-alias "$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]' | sed -E 's/[^a-z0-9]+/-/g; s/^-+|-+$//g')"
